product_overview: A web frontend for farm operations that provides secure authentication, an operational dashboard, employee CRUD, and user settings with robust error handling and API validation.
core_goals: Provide secure, token-based authentication (access + refresh) with clear token lifecycle management
Surface farm operational metrics on a responsive dashboard for quick decision-making
Support full CRUD for farm employees with server-side validation and DB constraint awareness
Allow users to update profile and application settings safely with validation
Implement global error handling and API interceptors to gracefully recover from expired tokens and surface actionable errors
Ensure client-server payloads match backend DTOs and validation errors are presented clearly to users
Log and surface server-side errors for diagnostics while showing friendly messages to end users

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login, logout, and token lifecycle management (issue, refresh, invalidate) used by the rest of the app.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with {username, password} -> Receive 200 with {accessToken, refreshToken} -> GET /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> -> Receive 200 with user profile
POST /api/auth/refresh with {refreshToken} -> Receive 200 with new {accessToken, refreshToken} -> POST /api/auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> -> Receive 204 No Content
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error message
POST /api/auth/refresh with expired or revoked refreshToken -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error indicating refresh token invalid

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main landing page providing overview metrics and KPIs for the farm; requires authentication to view protected data.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with tokens -> GET /api/dashboard with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> -> Receive 200 with overview metrics and stat cards

GET /api/dashboard with expired accessToken -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/refresh with {refreshToken} -> Receive 200 with new tokens -> GET /api/dashboard with new accessToken -> Receive 200 with overview metrics
GET /api/dashboard -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error with error payload (stack trace/exception details) indicating server-side failure

features.name: Employee Management
features.description: Create, read, update, and delete farm employee records; enforces DTO validation and handles DB-level constraints.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with tokens -> POST /api/employees with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and body {name, employeeType, companyCode, employeeNumber} -> Receive 201 Created with created employee -> GET /api/employees/:id with Authorization -> Receive 200 with employee details
PUT /api/employees/:id with Authorization and body {role, phone} -> Receive 200 with updated employee
DELETE /api/employees/:id with Authorization -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/employees/:id with Authorization -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /api/employees with Authorization and body missing required companyCode -> Receive 400 Bad Request with field validation errors (e.g., companyCode: 'must not be null')
POST /api/employees with Authorization and duplicate unique field employeeNumber -> Receive 409 Conflict with error indicating unique constraint violation

features.name: Settings
features.description: User profile and application settings management (update profile, preferences).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with tokens -> PUT /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and body {displayName, email, preferences} -> Receive 200 with updated profile -> GET /api/profile with Authorization -> Receive 200 with updated profile
PUT /api/profile with Authorization and invalid email format -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error for email field

features.name: Error Handling
features.description: Global error boundary in the UI and API interceptors for consistent user-facing error messages, automatic token refresh, and client-side logging of server errors.
user_flows: GET /api/protected with expired accessToken -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/refresh with {refreshToken} -> Receive 200 with new tokens -> Original request retried GET /api/protected with new accessToken -> Receive 200 OK

GET /api/dashboard -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error with error payload -> POST /api/logs (or /api/errors) with client-captured error details and context -> Receive 201 Created acknowledging the error log; ErrorBoundary renders a friendly fallback UI

GET /api/dashboard with network failure (no response) -> Network error occurs (no HTTP response) -> Frontend ErrorBoundary captures the error and renders fallback UI and optionally POST /api/logs with offline/error context -> Receive 201 Created or queued logging when network returns
